title: Think and position yourself like a consultant

say: Think and position yourself like a consultant.
This is the video for module one of Consulting Fundamentals.
A consultant is paid to help a client make a better decision or fix a defined problem. The client owns the business and the final decision.

say: Clients hire people who describe their problem more clearly than they can.

panel.heading: Three things a client pays for

cards.d: Confidence that you describe their problem more clearly than they can.
A named, repeatable way of working, for example a four-week review with three stages.
Fewer errors, faster processing, more paying customers, a decision made with evidence.

say: Clients say sales are bad, or staff are not serious. Turn that into one specific key question with a time frame, that leads to a decision.

panel.heading: Key question, issue tree, hypothesis
items: Turn the complaint into one key question
Split it into a MECE issue tree
Use formulas: profit = revenue minus costs
Test hypotheses, and say what proves you wrong

say: Break it into an issue tree. Good trees are MECE: the branches do not overlap, and together they cover every possible cause.

say: The easiest trees follow arithmetic. Profit is revenue minus costs. Revenue is customers times average spend.

say: A hypothesis is a best guess you set out to prove or disprove. Write down what result would prove you wrong, so you do not notice only the evidence that agrees with you.

say: The consultant compares the same month last year, branch by branch of the tree.

card.title: Where did the pharmacy's profit go?

say: Revenue is 18,850,000 naira. It actually rose by 850,000 naira, so sales are not the problem.

card.title: Where did the pharmacy's profit go?

say: Cost of goods is 14,140,000 naira. That is about 75% of revenue, up from 70% last year.

card.title: Where did the pharmacy's profit go?

say: Operating costs rose by 400,000 naira, to 4,000,000.

card.title: Where did the pharmacy's profit go?

say: Profit fell from 1,800,000 to 710,000 naira. The higher cost-of-goods share explains about 945,000 of the 1,090,000 drop. So the consultant checks supplier prices, expired stock and stock losses, not advertising.

say: Score each market from 1 to 5 for value to the client, and for your ability to win. Chiamaka, a public health nurse in Enugu, has run household surveys and knows two programme managers. NGOs are her first market.

panel.heading: Start where value and winnability meet

say: A state agency scores high on value, but she has no registered company or procurement record yet. She builds towards it.
Larger buyers expect CAC registration, a tax number, a business account and a short capability statement.

panel.heading: Start where value and winnability meet

say: Real clients do not charge you to hire you, so never pay a registration fee for a contract. Never send your BVN, card details or one-time codes to anyone.
With remote clients, use verified payment channels and take a deposit. Keep any personal data in password-protected folders, and use it only for the agreed purpose.

panel.heading: Protect yourself and client data
items: Never pay a fee to receive a contract
Never send your BVN, card details or codes
Use payment channels you can verify
Take a deposit before starting
Keep client personal data secure
